questions.q: What is the stated purpose of the IT asset management practice in ITIL 4?
options: To plan and manage the full lifecycle of all IT assets to maximize value, control costs, manage risks, support reuse/retirement decisions, and meet regulatory and contractual requirements
To record which CIs relate to which other CIs
To approve or reject proposed changes before they go live
To resolve incidents as quickly as possible
questions.explain: The purpose statement is heavily financial and contractual in language -- cost, risk, regulatory, contractual -- which is the tell that this is a business-facing practice.

questions.q: Which of these is part of an IT asset's full lifecycle as described in this lesson?
options: Only the moment it is purchased
Planning, procurement, deployment, operation, and retirement
Only its technical relationship to other configuration items
Only the incident tickets logged against it
questions.explain: Asset management owns visibility across the entire arc from planning through disposal, not just a single snapshot.

questions.q: A single laptop can be tracked as both a CI and an asset at the same time. What distinguishes the two concerns?
options: There is no real distinction -- it's the same tracking done twice
A CI is tracked for its role in delivering a service; an asset is tracked for its financial, contractual, or lifecycle value
A CI is always more expensive than an asset
Only servers can be CIs, and only laptops can be assets
questions.explain: Configuration management cares whether the laptop's role in a service is understood; asset management cares about its purchase cost, warranty, license, and depreciation.

questions.q: Why does software license compliance belong to IT asset management rather than configuration management?
options: License compliance is actually a security practice, not an ITSM practice
It's a contractual and financial question about entitlement to use software, unrelated to how that software relates to other CIs
Configuration management has no connection to software at all
License compliance was recently moved out of ITIL 4 entirely
questions.explain: Whether usage exceeds what's licensed is about the terms under which the asset was acquired, which is squarely an asset management concern.

questions.q: Which of the following is an example of a decision that good asset data directly enables, per this lesson?
options: Deciding whether to reuse an existing laptop for a new hire instead of purchasing a new one
Diagnosing the root cause of a recurring network outage
Approving a change request for a production database migration
Writing a knowledge article for the service desk
questions.explain: Reuse-versus-purchase is exactly the kind of lifecycle decision asset data (age, warranty status, condition) is meant to support.
